svg.title: Source and sink balance over time
svg.desc: Two line charts sharing a time axis: median Chronons held and median Energy held by cohort.
svg.text: Source and sink balance over time: Chronons and Energy held
Median holdings by day, moderate walkers. A rising Energy line is inflation: in the Chronon-bound
late game no journey is active, so step Energy has no sink and is spent in one burst when the next
price is paid (no cap in this analytical baseline).
Synthetic players; every economy value is hypothetical. Data: full_economy_v2/outputs/timeline.csv
